# `^BT` – TLC39 Bar Code

[Overview](../README.md) · [Libraries](../libraries/README.md) · [Commands](README.md) · [Features](../features/README.md) · [Evidence legend](../METHODOLOGY.md) · [Compare images](../../benchmarks/accuracy/README.md)


Print a TLC39 composite barcode combining Code 39 and MicroPDF417 for TCIF telecommunications tagging.

Reference parameters: **o, w1, r1, h1, w2, h2**. These describe the reference grammar, not a promise that any library honors every parameter. [Zebra guide, page 140](../../zpl-zbi2-pg-en.pdf).
